schema: namespace Acme { entity User in Group; entity Group; entity Photo; entity Album; action all; action view in [all] appliesTo { principal: [User, Group], resource: [Photo, Album], context: {} }; action edit appliesTo { principal: User, resource: Photo, context: {} }; }

cases.name: head-types
cases.policies: permit(principal is Acme::User, action, resource is Acme::Photo);

cases.name: template-type
cases.policies: permit(principal is Acme::User in ?principal, action, resource);

cases.name: multiple-namespaces
cases.schema: namespace A { entity Z; } namespace B { entity A; } entity Photo; action view appliesTo {principal: [A::Z, B::A], resource: Photo, context: {}};
